incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-queue-backlog-prod — 48k queued tokens across inference-workers (p90 queue time 3.6s)
pagerduty: Alert details: trigger=inference-queue-backlog-prod, severity=sev2, runbook=https://redwood.runbooks/inference-queue-backlog
alex_w: Acking and taking ownership. I'll start triage — pinging @miguel for autoscaling checks.
alex_w: Quick check: is this localized to a region or global?
sara_m: Seeing increased 502s on /v1/embeddings and timeout spikes on chat-gen route in us-west-2. Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/inference/latency?orgId=1
miguel: Autoscaler is receiving backpressure but hasn't scaled fast enough — ASG target CPU at 80% and we have cold-start throttling. Looks like GPU pool allocation for dedicated nodes hit soft quota.
oncall: I'm oncall and nearby. If autoscaler can't pickup, we should do manual scale + temporary routing to smaller model variant.
ops_lead: Agreed. Two mitigations: 1) scale inference-workers to 20 replicas now, 2) route low-priority traffic to gpt-medium-1. Both are quick and reversible.
alex_w: Doing manual scale now:```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-workers --replicas=20
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference-workers
```
(alex_w posts): kubectl output: scaled up to 20, rollout complete on 6 nodes so far, 14 pending due to GPU allocation delay.
miguel: GPU allocation taking ~90s per node. I'll push a temporary routing rule to send embeddings to gpt-medium-1 for 15m. Patching traffic rule now.```json
{ "route": "/v1/embeddings", "priority": "low", "fallback_model": "gpt-medium-1", "ttl": "15m" }
```
sara_m: Patch applied. Starting to see error rate for embeddings drop but latency for chat-gen still high. Can we also enable KV prefix cache for chat-gen? Might shave tokens off.
oncall: Enable prefix caching using the runtime flag:```bash
redwoodctl runtime set --service chat-gen --kv-cache enabled
```
alex_w: Enabled caching. Monitoring.
pagerduty: Note: escalation timer at 9m if no recovered state.
cs_rep: Heads-up — customer X reported 10-20% slower responses in the last 10m. They may open a ticket. I told them we're investigating and will follow up.
ops_lead: Good note. Alex/Sara, collect a short impact blurb for customers: estimate affected percentage, approximate time window, and mitigation steps.
alex_w: Early estimate: ~12% of production requests experienced >2s extra latency between 1998765400 and 1998765580 UTC. No data loss, retries handled by client.
sara_m: From logs: ~4% 502 rate for embeddings at peak, now down to 0.5% post-routing. p95 latency for chat-gen improved from 1.8s to 0.9s after scale+cache.
miguel: Autoscaler stabilized and new nodes have joined. Queue length trending down.
oncall: Quick status check — are we at steady state?
alex_w: Queue length back to baseline 60s ago. Metrics show p95 under SLO, errors minimal.
ops_lead: I'll mark as under control. @pagerduty, please note ack by alex_w, mitigation done, monitoring for 30m.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by alex_w. Status: under control. Next check-in in 30 minutes.
cs_rep: I'll follow up with customer X with this blurb: "We observed elevated inference latency affecting a subset of requests for ~20 minutes due to queueing and GPU allocation delays. We mitigated by scaling capacity and routing lower-priority requests to a smaller model. No data loss; requests retried successfully. We're monitoring and will follow up with a post-incident summary."
oncall: Followups: 1) postmortem runbook entry, 2) adjust autoscaler thresholds or pre-warm pool, 3) consider faster fallback policy for embeddings route. Assigning followups to @miguel (autoscale), @sara_m (postmortem writeup), @alex_w (customer notes).
ops_lead: Great. If anything regresses, re-open the PD incident. Otherwise we'll let PD auto-close after monitoring window.
incident-bot: Monitoring window started (30m) — will post final status when window closes.
alex_w: Thx team. Adding timeline to the incident board. I'll drop logs and commands used in the incident channel for the postmortem.
ops_lead: Closing note: no further action required right now. Will schedule a follow-up sync tomorrow to discuss pre-warm strategy. :thumbsup:
__notes: generated by dataset-gen: incident thread emulating PagerDuty ack, manual scaling, routing fallback, customer update, and follow-ups
